description: This file defines a class Smarty_Undefined_Variable that extends Smarty_Variable, handling cases where variables are undefined within the Smarty templating engine. It provides methods to handle property access and string conversion for such variables.

classes.name: Smarty_Undefined_Variable
classes.description: A class that represents an undefined variable in Smarty, providing default behavior for property access (__get) and string conversion (__toString).

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Returns null when trying to access any property of this undefined variable.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns an empty string when the object is converted to a string.
